description: This file defines the PartitionEndpointProvider class, which manages AWS endpoint partitions, including methods for retrieving partitions by region or name, creating default providers, and merging prefix data.

classes.name: PartitionEndpointProvider
classes.description: Manages AWS endpoint partitions, providing methods to retrieve and merge partition data, and to create default providers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with partitions, default partition, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the object to be called as a function to get a partition based on arguments.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition matching the given region and service, or the default if no match.

methods.name: getPartitionByName
methods.description: Returns the partition with the specified name.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default SDK partition provider with merged endpoint data.

methods.name: mergePrefixData
methods.description: Merges endpoint prefix data into the main partition data for services.
